stories.title: 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% for first time since 2007 as oil prices surge
stories.summary: The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield climbed above 5% for the first time since the 2007 financial crisis as surging oil prices and rate expectations pressured bonds. The move raises borrowing costs for the US economy ahead of this week's Federal Reserve decision.

stories.title: Imran Khan's sons accuse Pakistan army chief of vendetta, fear ex-PM is being 'slowly killed' in prison
stories.summary: Kasim and Sulaiman Khan told the Guardian that military chief Asim Munir is pursuing a personal grudge against their imprisoned father, and allege his prison conditions amount to mistreatment. Pakistan's Supreme Court is due to rule this week on Khan's medical care and family-access case.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google have been in talks on AI safety for weeks
stories.summary: TechCrunch reports the three leading AI labs have held weeks of discussions on AI safety, amid industry debate over whether the reported AI development slowdown amounts to a safety pact or a cartel. The talks come as frontier labs face mounting scrutiny over model risk.

stories.title: Nitter and XCancel are dead (again) after X's latest legal actions
stories.summary: X's latest legal actions appear to have taken down Nitter, the widely used Twitter mirror service, and XCancel, a tool for tracking users who canceled X premium subscriptions. Both services had previously resurfaced after earlier takedowns.

stories.title: Early Anthropic hire and former METR COO found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
stories.summary: A startup founded by an early Anthropic employee and the former COO of AI-safety evaluator METR claims to have built a system for constraining out-of-control autonomous AI agents. The announcement arrives as 'agentic' AI models draw growing safety scrutiny.

stories.title: Salesforce and Nvidia's new reasoning model is 'everything the AI labs should fear'
stories.summary: Salesforce and Nvidia have unveiled a new AI reasoning model they tout as an alternative to the frontier-lab approach. TechCrunch argues the model signals growing competition to the major AI labs from outside the research establishment.

stories.title: Browns place RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve, sign Jaleel McLaughlin
stories.summary: Cleveland moved running back Dylan Sampson to injured reserve after the knee injury he suffered in the Week 1 loss to Jacksonville, sidelining him for at least four weeks. The team signed Jaleel McLaughlin from its practice squad in a corresponding move.

stories.title: Browns RB Dylan Sampson expected on IR as Deshaun Watson's rough week continues
stories.summary: After a 34-10 season-opening loss to the Jaguars, the Browns may be without backup running back Dylan Sampson for an extended stretch after he hurt his left knee, with reports saying he is headed to injured reserve. Starter Deshaun Watson also drew scrutiny after a shaky Week 1 outing that included an interception.

stories.title: Ryan Day sends clear message to Buckeyes after stunning loss to Texas
stories.summary: Ohio State head coach Ryan Day stressed accountability and focus after the Buckeyes squandered a 20-point lead in a 24-23 loss at Texas. The defeat dropped Ohio State from No. 1 to No. 6 in both major polls, its first time outside the top five since 2024.

stories.title: Ohio State's Ryan Day and players reflect on Texas loss
stories.summary: Buckeyes coach Ryan Day and players addressed the fourth-quarter collapse that cost them the game at Texas, which knocked Ohio State from No. 1 to No. 6 in the coaches' and AP polls. It is the first time since 2024 the Buckeyes are ranked outside the top five.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock camera usage
stories.summary: NBC4 reports central Ohio municipalities are weighing how or whether to use Flock license-plate cameras, balancing crime-fighting benefits against privacy concerns. The debate touches communities including Columbus and suburbs such as Gahanna.

stories.title: One killed in shooting on Columbus' South Side
stories.summary: Columbus police investigated a fatal shooting on the city's South Side where one person was found dead in an alley. No arrests were immediately reported.

stories.title: Dip in Columbus gas prices doesn't erase $4-per-gallon average
stories.summary: A recent slide in Columbus-area gas prices has yet to bring the local average below $4 a gallon. The modest decline follows a broader drop in oil prices, but pump costs remain elevated locally.
